processors.script:
const input = JSON.parse(context.getBody()).body; context.setBody(`This email was sent from the website, from: ${input.fromName}<${input.fromEmail}>

${input.message}`)

context.sendToStep(`aws-services`, `ses-request`, JSON.stringify( { path : `/v2/email/outbound-emails`, method : `POST`, body : { FromEmailAddress: context.getData(`fromAddress`), Destination : { ToAddresses : JSON.parse(context.getData(`toAddress`))}, Content: { Simple : { Subject: { Data: context.getData(`subject`) }, Body : { Text : { Data : context.getBody() }}}}}}))
